title: Zephyr: Announce encode/decode
close_reason: Implemented canonical Zephyr Announce body encode/decode and scheduler serialization: spec-defined 193-byte/100-byte limits, SHA-512 IID derivation, domain-separated signed transcript including app-data length, exact announce_signed_data vector coverage, round-trip and boundary tests. Modified production and test objects compile under pinned Zephyr 3.7; canonical vector oracle suite passes 16/16. Full suite link remains blocked by unrelated pre-existing lichen_util/Schnorr/router base failures.
